multiple lines
and select keyword */" + "
 " + "(" + " " + "a" + " " + "different" + " " + "// comment
" + "//and a comment /* containing comment */ and then some more" + ")" + " " + "from" + " " + "t" + ")" + ")" + "/* a comment after close paren */" + " " + "(" + "'quoted'" + " " + "'string with ''single and "double"" quote'" + ")";
    String expected = "SELECT
" + "ID(12)
" + "ID(*)
" + "ID(1.23e45)
" + "LPAREN
" + "DQID("an id")
" + "COMMA
" + "DQID("an id with ""quotes' inside")
" + "COMMA
" + "COMMENT
" + "LPAREN
" + "ID(a)
" + "ID(different)
" + "COMMENT
" + "COMMENT
" + "RPAREN
" + "FROM
" + "ID(t)
" + "RPAREN
" + "RPAREN
" + "COMMENT
" + "LPAREN
" + "SQID('quoted')
" + "SQID('string with ''single and "double"" quote')
" + "RPAREN
";
    assertTokenizesTo(sql, expected);
    // Tokenizer should be lenient if input ends mid-token
    assertTokenizesTo("select /* unfinished comment", "SELECT
COMMENT
");
    assertTokenizesTo("select // unfinished comment", "SELECT
COMMENT
");
    assertTokenizesTo("'starts with string'", "SQID('starts with string')

    assertTokenizesTo("'unfinished string", "SQID('unfinished string)

    assertTokenizesTo(""unfinished double-quoted id", "DQID("unfinished double-quoted id)

    assertTokenizesTo("123", "ID(123)

}
